About.Description: Nearby Transfer sends files between devices over the local network. Phones and computers on the same Wi-Fi are discovered automatically — no cable, no account, just tap to transfer.
About.Features:
• Automatic discovery of devices on the same subnet, or manual IP connect
• Automatic secure pairing, AES-256 encrypted transfers
• Chunked HTTP transfer for large files; pause / resume / resume-after-interrupt
• SHA-256 integrity verification
• Drag-and-drop send, multi-file batch transfer
• Light / dark theme and multi-language support
About.Technology: Built with .NET and Avalonia, cross-platform on Windows / Android.
